ask: Is renewing the sign-in and asking once more the right fix?
problem: A web tab left idle for half an hour woke up and failed to sync a language. The person saw an error, though nothing was lost.
found: The tab woke holding an old sign-in key. The server said the key had expired. The app treated that as a server fault and stopped.
changed: Now the app renews the sign-in and asks once more. If that works, the sync finishes with no error. If renewing fails, the app counts it as offline and tries later.
why: The draft only treated the answer as offline, so the sync waited ten minutes. Renewing at once fixes it sooner. Every request here is safe to repeat. Why renewal sometimes fails is a separate issue and is left alone.
touches: All requests the sync sends to the server share this step. Nothing else changes.
